notes.title: Toy Tactics 1.1A: Release Notes
notes.content:
We're excited to bring you the latest update for Toy Tactics! This patch addresses several key issues and introduces important fixes to improve your gameplay experience. We’ve been listening closely to your feedback and have worked hard to make sure everything runs smoother than ever. Below is a list of the most significant changes in this update:

Fixes and Changes:
[list]
[*] All achievements are now working.
[*] Polish and Czech special characters have been fixed.
[*] Drawing bugs and missing orders have been resolved.
[*] Minor errors and access problems have been addressed.
[*] Online countdown issues have been fixed.
[*] Emote selection is now supported when using a controller.
[*] Skeleton altar now works for allies in co-op.
[/list]

We hope these improvements enhance your experience with Toy Tactics. As always, we appreciate your continued support and feedback. Stay tuned for more updates, and don't hesitate to let us know if you encounter any other issues or have suggestions for future improvements. Keep those strategies sharp and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Final Update Before Launch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/9354bcdbebb928a7903e1d55216b62e4b72038c4.png[/img]
[h3]As we approach the official release, we’re excited to announce that everything is now finalized. Get ready to sharpen your skills, because the upcoming game modes available at launch will be [b]Multiplayer Versus (1vs1)[/b] and [b]Multiplayer Cooperative (1+1 vs AI)[/b].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/38eae21483370cff79208b1b920190ce78d61738.png[/img]

    [h3]What’s New in This Update:[/h3][list]
        [*][b]Touchscreen Support:[/b] You can now enjoy full touchscreen functionality.
        [*][b]Scene Updates & Balancing:[/b] Multiple scenes have been updated and rebalanced for better gameplay.
        [*][b]Skirmish Mode Warning:[/b] A new alert will notify you if you attempt to start Skirmish mode without any spells equipped.
        [*][b]Unit Videos in Army Camp:[/b] Watch your units in action with new videos available in the army camp.
        [*][b]Boss Improvements:[/b] Fixed boss attack cancellations and rebalanced their difficulty for a more engaging challenge.
        [*][b]Customization:[/b] Your selected colors are now saved automatically.
        [*][b]Visual Upgrades:[/b] Decals have been replaced with a new system, and trails and particle render orders have been refined.
        [*][b]Enhanced performance:[/b] Improvements to ensure smoother gameplay and faster load times.
        [*][b]Environmental Updates:[/b] Removed underwater vegetation to enhance performance.
        [*][b]Cinematic Additions:[/b][list]
                [*]Visualize army cinematics directly from the camp.
                [*]Enjoy the new boss ending cinematics, everytime you defeat any boss.[/list]		
        [*][b]Gameplay Tweaks:[/b][list]
                [*]Karts now halt when captured by enemies.
                [*]Chest retrieval mechanics have been revised for specific scenarios.
                [*]Improved arrow sticking for more realistic interactions.
                [*]Reworked pathfinding costs for navigating through and around buildings, both intact and destroyed.[/list]
        [*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][list]
                [*]Various achievements have been corrected.
                [*]Spells on top of buildings are now functioning as intended.
                [*]Resolved issues with specific spells, including Trojan Horse, Galleon, and Barrels.
                [*]Relic fixes, including adjustments to Ghost Area, Wolf Cloak, and Ancilia.[/list]
        [*][b]Audio & Visual Enhancements:[/b][list]
                [*]Credits audio now respects master volume settings.
                [*]Simplified Fireflight light effects for better performance.
                [*]Campaign markers have been resized and modified for improved clarity.[/list][/list]
This will likely be the final update before the official launch, so dive in and explore these changes as you prepare for the big day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/479deeb53943317fb77fb45b1e1dec8916e6d306.png[/img]

notes.title: New content! New victories!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/a1d3cc4c61a3fdc810ed65d51f7808153612d293.png[/img]

Hello, commanders! We have tons of info to share with you today, so let’s get to the most important part first.

One final content update before the release date approaches. That’s right, on June 6th you’ll get your strategic hands on some new toys.

New mode! ⚔

- Skirmish! Conquer and defend unit-producing buildings to survive all the incoming waves.

New languages! 💬

-16 languages fully implemented.
-2 voiceover languages ready: English and Spanish

New cinematics, animations and interface! 🎥

-12 cinematics ready, with voiceovers and subtitles in every language.
-New and improved menu and interface appearance.
-New 2D animations for Sun Tzu and army leaders in the campaign map.
-New tutorial videos for units and spells.

Balance and gameplay improvements, performance enhancements,  and bug fixes ⚙🐜🚫

-Spells and relics revisited, improved and rebalanced.
-Unit balance improved to increase differentiation between factions.
-All campaign missions and bosses improved and rebalanced.
-Secondary gameplay modes reworked, including Creative, Challenges and Mercenaries.
-Creative and Mercenaries mode now allow for color change and relic selection.
-Improved quality and performance correlation to adapt the visuals to any hardware.
-New render pipeline to improve performance and appearance.
-Bug fixes and corrections.

This new update comes exactly on June 6th, when we will be participating in Guerrilla Collective with tons of other amazing indie devs and publishers. Coincidence? I don’t think so. 

Don’t miss out, see you on June 6th! 

TOY TACTICS nominated for Best Gameplay on BIG Festival 

We are also honored to be nominated for an awesome award: Best Gameplay at BIG Festival, which will happen later this month in the festive city of Sao Paulo. Thanks Brazil for loving Toy Tactics as much as we do!

Big Festival is a major game festival in Latin America organized by gamescom latam. This is Big!  Sun Tzu says we have the prize in the bag, but even if we don’t win, we are really happy to be nominated. 

Release date incoming! ⚔️ Keep an eye on the Future Games Show on June 8th!

After years of working on Toy Tactics, we are finally ready for the full release. You will know the official release date during the Future Games Show, which will happen on June 8th. 🎆🎆🎆

Watch Future Games Show on YouTube. Set up your reminder right here: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1jXmyz452hs]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1jXmyz452hs[/url]

Don’t forget! June 8th! You’ll know all our secrets then 💥

notes.title: PAX East 2024 and the latest from Toy Tactics
notes.content:
[h2]PAX East 2024 was amazing! It took place from March 21-24 and is the first physical event of the year that Toy Tactics attended.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/808a1ad0176b593c88db93464220b78498a44f24.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/a92b79313903f9e11d413bbfd7c02f55caff4b73.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/a6c0b131e771f51fe2b83d487b1b6f0a2ab5f3bc.jpg[/img]

We have always enjoyed being in these type of events but this year was very special: we had a solo booth for Toy Tactics where we received a lot of people of all ages, influencers and press, who enjoyed the game, gave us their feedback and as a thank you for stopping by, we gave away exclusive merch for them to take home a little bit of Toy Tactics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/05f817b8ad054c2d2372131c075fe48bdc564d1e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/e3e3ce6829008d90b917ddd9c6fc94c5736c55c5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/969611a3dec57a569556e2d5c456743383628890.jpg[/img]

Really, you don't know how grateful we are for your kind comments, to all the people who came back to play 3 or 4 times because they fell in love with Toy Tactics and for all the support during and after the event. All this love inspires us and we are more than excited to announce that [b]Toy Tactics will be fully released on all consoles in Q3 of this year[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/3daba9201d1e79481c4c6d88eef8589bb6fa164c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/5e798c3026d0c7b740e841105e7e6c55e0046aa0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/f485b34538b7795668d78c2387c56282def0a312.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]The latest on Toy Tactics: [/b][/h2]

Toy Tactics was launched in Early Access in March 2023, and since then, it has received significant content updates, resulting in over 25 hours of gameplay where you can enjoy:

[list]
[*] [b]5 armies with their own abilities:[/b] Imperium (Roman Army), Pendragon (Medieval Army), Kyoukai (Samurai Army), Freebooters (Pirates Army), and Draugr (Skeleton Army: Before your enemies, now you can control them). 
[*] [b]6 unique main units[/b] (infantry, archer, cavalry, heroe, king and queen) [b]and unique secondary units[/b] (animals, siege units, and special units). More than 40 units available with different strengths and weaknesses.
[*] [b]5 different spell trees:[/b] one per faction, with 16 spells related to the main abilities of the armies. 80 different spells to cast anywhere 💀
[*] [b]5 relic collections:[/b] one collection per faction, 3 relics to choose for each unit to change passive abilities, 18 relics per army and 90 different relics.
[*] [b]5 settings:[/b] including terrains, vegetation, trees and faction related contraptions.
[*] [b]6 final bosses.[/b]
[*] [b]5 playing modes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Campaign:[/b] 5 campaigns with more than 60 levels filled with primary and secondary objectives.
[*] [b]Skirmish:[/b] 5 long levels to conquer and defend while producing new units.
[*] [b]Puzzles:[/b] 6 campaigns with over 60 puzzles to solve, based on strategic concepts. 
[*] [b]Mercenaries:[/b] 6 mercenary campaigns to beat while buying any unit within an initial budget. More than 60 challenges available.
[*] [b]Creative:[/b] 10 different levels in which to create your own battles.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2][b]What to expect at full release? [/b][/h2]

[b]Toy Tactics will arrive on all consoles this year[/b], featuring a mode highly anticipated by many: [b]online multiplayer[/b].

In the "multiplayer mode," you'll be able to engage in both competitive and cooperative experiences.

On one hand, there's "1vs1," which will be the "competitive mode" where you'll face off against another player, where strategic skill and quick decision-making will be paramount.

Looking for an intense battle? In 1vs1 battles, you can carefully build your army, select powerful relics and spells, and meticulously plan your tactics to emerge victorious.

On the other hand, in the "cooperative mode," you can have your ally, join forces, and combat the formidable opponent controlled by the AI. Together, you'll need to devise strategies, coordinate your actions, and efficiently produce units to survive the relentless siege.

All roads lead to Rome... and victory! ⚔️

Whether competing head-to-head or joining forces to defeat your enemy, with Toy Tactics' multiplayer modes, you'll experience exhilarating, prolonged skirmish battles full of excitement and challenge.

Stay tuned for more news and remember that Toy Tactics is currently in [b]Early Access[/b], so you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1772530/Toy_Tactics/]buy it right now[/url] and share your duels with us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/Jx8YrQVYCq]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Toy Tactics Undead Army Update 🔮💀
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=VVG_QnGAn-Y;full][/previewyoutube]
Attention, Tacticians!

I hope you're doing great, or at least feeling a bit better than us... lately, we've been feeling a bit dead inside, not because of anything bad, mind you, but because the entire studio has been working hard on Toy Tactics' latest update: The Awakening of the Undead 💀

This latest update adds a new faction, The Draugr, and with them comes a whole new campaign, new units, new relics, new spells based in necromancy and even a new ship!!

🎃 [b]Limited-Time Demo[/b]: In celebration of Halloween, we're summoning a chilling, limited-time demo for all brave souls. A glimpse into the land of the Skeleton Army and show your enemies that only death is welcome in this land.

[h2]Here's what awaits you in the darkness:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Play as the Undead Army: Your familiar foes are now under your control!
[*]New Spells + Units: Don't worry if the corpses start piling up, your new necromancer ability will bring your enemies back to life and join your army.
[*]New Sceneries: Explore the land of Erebus, a lifeless landscape filled with lava ☄️ where only the Undead can thrive.
[*]Limited-time Halloween Demo: A glimpse into the haunted realm, available for a limited spell.
[*]New game modes: Challenges that will put your strategic skills to the test, like never before.
[/list]
We're eternally grateful for the support you've bestowed upon us. As you embark on this hair-raising adventure with us, keep a watchful eye for what's coming next in Toy Tactics. The Undead Army is rising, and the wobbliest strategy game around is about to get even spookier! 💀👻🎮

notes.title: ⚔️ Dev Diary #3 - Mercenary and Puzzle modes ⚔️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/63d3393ab94182c73fa4dfa6fb05441c51562b5d.png[/img]
Hey Tacticians!

We're thrilled to share with you the latest progress on our project! During Strategy Festival Toy Tactics will be on discount, make sure to grab it while you can! Without further ado, let’s dive right in!

[h2][b]Here’s what to expect:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Changes to Mercenaries
[*]New Challenges and Content
[/list]
[h2][b]⚔️ MERCENARIES ⚔️[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/337ac94a73a2964f5c9e040f14148b374d6b4356.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]WHAT'S THE BUZZ[/b][/h3]

With hard work paying off, we have some exciting news - face off against various groups of foes in quick and the many levels we have added. The twist? Here, you can purchase an array of units, powers, and even animals to aid you in your epic battles. But be careful not to over spend, as your budget is limited, which demands strategic choices for the players.

[h3][b]FEATURES[/b][/h3]

You’ll be able to explore diverse settings, each featuring unique situations for every faction, as well as a wide variety of units and powers to construct your ultimate lineup:
[list]
[*]Roman
[*]Medieval
[*]Samurai
[*]Pirate
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/a0071c8ccdc6bac9262d5bed5635c63d92809eab.jpg[/img]
Have you ever thought about using animals as bait? Now we have you covered with options like sheep, pigs, and even cows!

In this update, you can master the art of economic management and combat strategy as you progress through levels, facing the most hilarious and absurd situations imaginable.

[h3][b]WHY YOU SHOULD DIVE IN[/b][/h3]

The Mercenary mode is where the real magic happens. It's a complete departure from your usual campaign strategy, embracing trial and error with fast progression. All scenarios are unprecedentedly wacky, which we believe will keep you hooked for hours!

[h2][b]⚔️ CHALLENGES AND NEW CONTENT ⚔️[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/df6d1335ca45ee5ce3a6d9ebb9c697d477b95d23.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Several levels have been added corresponding to each playable faction. The creation of these levels has been based on the special feature/gift/power that the faction has.

[list] 
[*][b]Roman[/b] = Rebuild ruins/structures. 
[*][b]Medieval[/b] = Leader fusions with specific units. 
[*][b]Samurai[/b] = Stealth in the fog. 
[*][b]Pirates[/b] = Ghost mode that allows you to go through things and the 
ability to be a little faster than other units in the water.
[/list]
[*]Basic levels have been balanced to get the best playable experience.
[*]The UI of the challenge mode has been improved.
[*]The progress of played/completed challenges is now saved.
[*]Spells can now be used in challenge mode.
[*]Fixed some bugs 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/ffbe8f7c4d1bf420e7698816a1fe8b024ce60a31.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]CHALLENGE MODE WHY?[/b][/h3]

With the challenge mode, your strategies will change with the new puzzle mode that is small, quick, and concise, and that you can repeat several times. You can use this knowledge in any other game mode, mainly in the campaign.

[h3][b]WHAT DOES IT ADD?[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/c9d7ef2427d9ef5e733ea22d21c6436e1921ff5d.png[/img]
We know that it is important in a game of strategies and physics to be able to exploit them to get the most out of it. Good, quality content. With this mode, the game is approached differently than in the campaign.

[h3][b]LET'S TALK ABOUT LEVELS[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/176f8f196527155be7ed22b6046dc5c1f241b367.jpg[/img]
The challenge mode is divided into sections.
[list]
[*][b]Basic[/b]
[*][b]Roman[/b]
[*][b]Medieval[/b]
[*][b]Samurai[/b]
[*][b]Pirates[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/77d819d9fa60e0fda7db6b5f7ee469aad095ba92.jpg[/img]
[h4][b]Basic or essentials[/b][/h4] is a kind of tutorial that teaches the strategies of each unit, their strengths and weaknesses.

[h4][b]Roman[/b][/h4] We added the Roman mechanics factor: the ability to rebuild ruined structures. Catapults, towers, and the faction's unique spells with the element of fire predominating in many of them.

[h4][b]Medieval:[/b][/h4] The ability to merge leaders with different types of units. The weapon or skills are changed by merging them with different types of units (archers, infantry, cavalry and heroes) and playing with spells in which the element of ice predominates.

[h4][b]Samurai:[/b][/h4] As good ninjas, stealth and fog is a very important part of this faction. Different challenges have been built, and new weapons called ‘mortar’ or ‘rock’ throwers are also added, where the predominant element is the poison.

[h4][b]Pirates:[/b][/h4]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/4ded91fa4a8c48deecfd92f956b00ccdc7d7bc21.jpg[/img]
Mechanically, you can become ghosts for a few seconds by dragging the formation while a pirate melody plays. Water, since they are pirates, is also an important element. There are even some armed crabs that will help you in your battles!

Don't miss out on this opportunity to experience Toy Tactics in a whole new light. Download the update now and let the strategic chaos begin!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1772530/Toy_Tactics/

notes.title: New Content, New Conquers and much more!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=UOqp7THsvp4;full][/previewyoutube]
Hey there Tacticians!

It's been a journey, but we're proud to say that we've made significant strides. The new trailer video has been released and a few adjustments to the game have been made! We've been listening to your feedback and have been working diligently to bring forth the best gaming experience possible!

Here’s what to expect:
[list]
[*]Improved AI providing fresh challenges and difficulties to overcome
[*]Successive waves of aggressiveness among rival formations
[*]Upgraded petting system when approaching aggressive and friendly four-legged foes
[*]Revamped sound system including updated voices and UI sounds to set a heroic backdrop for an all-out offensive on the battlefield
[*]Newly implemented photo mode available in Creative mode and Challenges
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/20eea50ebee812d854a895e4da210261869ad633.png[/img]
Not only that, new content is lurking around the corner!

Keep an eye out for:
[list]
[*]New classes to come
[*]New locations on the map
[*]More captivating weapons and spells
[*]New bosses to battle
[/list]
Today at 19:00 CET, we are also participating on a podcast with [url=https://twitter.com/shoulduplayit?lang=en]ShouldUPlayIt[/url] here on Steam. Our lead developer will be talking about the game, the development, as well as new content that’s getting released! Make sure to join in on the fun, I was told a lot of toy soldier heads will be flying, castles will be blown to pieces, and victory flags will be taken!

We would like to thank you for all the support we have gotten so far and appreciate all the feedback! Keep an eye out for future updates, and always be ready to take the battles head on!

notes.title: 0.753 live
notes.content:
Hi all! We are happy to announce you the new version of the game, with multiple bugs fixed an QOL improvements!

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed giant chest in “The Lost Crusade” and enemy counter for a secondary objective.
[*] Fixed king attack range when joining with cavalry.
[*] Crows now work better in the main menu.
[*] Fixed the way enemy hero grabs chest in “The Lost Crusade”
[*] Fixed freezed build icons in Pier.
[*] Fixed random explosion when entering the first conquer area in Nimue’s Pond
[/list]

[h3]Progression[/h3]
[list]
[*] The default blessing for archers in the Roman campaign changed, it is now "Armour of Achilles".
[*] The blessing given on the 5th Roman level, hibernation, has changed, it is now "Arch of Apollo".
[/list]

[h3]Level objectives[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed "Defeat X units with your leader" objective has no counter.
[*] Fixed: A counter would be missing in the objective "Push 10 units into the void".
[/list]

[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved performance in all Pendragon levels
[*] HUD performance improved
[*] Small scripts optimizations
[/list]
